description: Coast Conservation and Coastal Resources Management Department - Proposed Fishery Harbour at Haraspola Balapitiya in Galle District. Environmental Impact Assessment Report
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory notice published under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act, No. 57 of 1981. It announces the public availability of an Environmental Impact Assessment Report for a proposed fishery harbor, which falls under regulatory compliance requirements and statutory procedures mandated by environmental legislation. The content focuses on legal notification requirements rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
